x: A personal record came from Bruce Barton in the steeplechase - under 10 minutes for the first time - and yet another came from Rob Draper in the 'B' race in spite of the fact that he had already raced over 1500m.

Said was delighted with his first ever Belgrave medal - it will not be his last - but less happy was young Rob Draper who had arrived in time for a 7 o'clock start and had to bitterly watch the medals go to his rivals who had been sent on their way at half past six: he had to settle for a 9:20 run a…

The performance of the afternoon, though, had to be the one set by Rob Draper - not in the 800, no, not the 1500 either. The high pressure hose used to fill the steeplechase water-jump was inadvertently dropped by the groundsman and seemed to take on the life of something from the Book of Revelation…
Rob Draper was looking for a fast race in the 1500m but got more than he bargained for as the leaders toured the route in well under 4 minute pace.
